title: CHAPTER 6: IMPORTANT PLACES AND TOURIST SITES IN TELANGANA

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Hyderabad forms the central historical and modern tourist destination in Telangana.
Warangal represents the medieval heritage and Kakatiya architectural legacy of the state.
Various other tourist sites across Telangana highlight its rich cultural, historical, and natural heritage.

blocks.content: Hyderabad, the capital of Telangana, is one of India's largest cities and a global hub for IT, pharma, and biotech. It is known as the 'City of Pearls' due to its historic pearl trade.

blocks.content: Warangal was the capital of the Kakatiya dynasty and is one of the most historically significant cities in Telangana.

items: Warangal Fort – Built by Kakatiyas; contains magnificent stone gateways (Kakatiya Kala Thoranam); now State Emblem
Thousand Pillar Temple (Rudreshwara) – Hanamkonda; built in 1163 CE; star-shaped platform; dedicated to Shiva, Vishnu, Surya
Ramappa Temple – 13th century masterpiece; UNESCO World Heritage Site 2021; floating bricks
Pakhal Lake and Bogatha Waterfalls – Eco-tourism sites
Bhadrakali Temple – Goddess worshipped in a unique reclining posture
Exams frequently test Kakatiya-era architecture and heritage monuments located in Warangal.
